title: WinMan: A Modern Window Manager and Workflow Accelerator for ImageJ/Fiji (v1.0.1)
description:
WinMan (v1.0.1) is a lightweight yet powerful utility plugin designed to streamline workspace management in ImageJ/Fiji. It addresses the 'desktop explosion' problem common in bioimage analysis workflows.

Key Features:

  • Smart Window Filtering: Close or keep windows based on title keywords (e.g., keep only 'C1' images).
  • Batch Image Tools: One-click 'Auto Contrast' and 'Reset Zoom' for all open images.
  • Layout Control: Modern flat UI with Tile/Cascade support.
  • Memory Monitor: Real-time RAM usage display with one-click Garbage Collection (GC).
